title: Manager, Software Engineering
description:
Do you want to advance your career with the world’s first cloud company? Since 1998, Oracle NetSuite has been on a mission to deliver an agile, unified application suite that gives leaders a complete view into their business. Our team is growing, and we’re looking for people like you to help us make a global impact.

As the leading cloud business system, NetSuite includes financials, inventory management, HR, professional services automation, commerce, and more. Tens of thousands of customers all over the world trust NetSuite to give their businesses the visibility, agility, and control needed to make data-informed decisions quickly. NetSuite is a place where you can build your career and have fun while doing so! We’re invested in our people, our customers, and the community. As part of Oracle, our benefits are second to none. Joining our passionate team means that you’re ready to take your career to the next level. With priceless learning opportunities, strong support, incredible innovation, and volunteer opportunities, NetSuite is committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels empowered and set up for success.

**Our company culture:**

* We help each other and foster collaboration across roles and teams.
* We lift each other up. We know how to celebrate our successes and learn from our failures.
* Ideas are fragile and we consider them no matter how simple or outlandish.
* We always try to do the right thing – for ourselves, for the product and ultimately for our customers.

**How will you crush it?**  
  
You'll work with awesome people that care about their craft and what they deliver. Your efforts will contribute to making things better for thousands of our customers.

You will collaborate strongly with our partners in Product Management, Security and Compliance – we’re all pulling in the same direction to deliver the secure, reliable software our customers want and need.

  

**You will fit perfectly if you share these values**

* People first.
* Manage a team of 7+ Engineers.
* Being open-minded for discussions and promoting team collaboration.
* Taking initiative, responsibility, and ownership of the projects.
* Driving continuous improvement of the team's productivity, product, and processes.
* Provide career growth and development opportunities for the team and build effective backup/succession plan to handle unanticipated attrition.
* Interact with product management and other engineering teams ( XD, Devops, Tech support, Release teams etc.) to develop / release software products which fulfill the requirements defined by the product owner.
* Provide technical leadership to the team for design, architecture, code reviews and incorporate engineering best practices into feature development, refactoring work and product maintenance.
* Determine the staffing required for scrum teams to complete assigned tasks. Facilitate the required trainings for the team to help them to complete their tasks.
* Experience working with Quality Leads.
* Responsible for hiring of software engineers for agile development teams.
* Mentor, train and motivate software engineers to increase overall technical skillsets and stay current with technology trends.
* Drive the annual performance reviews and appraisal process for the team.
* Participate in the campus / Industry hiring drives.
* Work with team to resolve customer issues as per defined service level agreements.
* Able to successfully deliver committed features on time and meeting project objectives/deadlines.
Participate in various scrum ceremonies such as Daily scrum calls , Sprint Planning, Sprint Retrospection  

**Qualifications/Skills**

* Bachelor/Master degree in computer engineering or equivalent.
* 12+ years of software development experience in a technical capacity and minimum 3 years of managerial experience.
* Expertise in any of the development technologies : Java or C#.
* Expertise in designing complex solutions, code reviews, providing architectural input on team-wide/cross-location projects, defining branching strategies and able to drive cross-team initiatives.
* Good familiarity with testing pyramid, test plans, automation, code coverage, continuous integration, performance and security testing.
* Monitoring the team productivity and maximizing utilization across various projects / initiatives.
* Keep up-to-date with technology trends & processes while driving adoption of the same , encourage innovation and lead knowledge sharing strategies. Should be able to pick up and deliver stories/tasks based on the project needs.
* Expertise in agile methodology and handling of scrum teams.
* Assist the team to unblock issues by providing effective resolutions.
* Delegate to engineers with clearly defined responsibility and empowerment.
* Expertise in dealing with performance management which includes regular 1-1's, performance /appraisal discussions with the engineer.
* Ensuring team is adhering to the organizational policies and guidelines.
* Proven ability to drive and enhance team engagement, fostering a collaborative and motivated work environment.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* Experienced in managing high performance teams , understanding their feedback and guide them in their career path.
* Ability to attract/recruit/retain talent
* Be a coach, mentor and employee champion.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to abstract functional requirements.

title: FBS Agile Dev Team Member III
description:
Agile Dev Team Members have collective responsibility for the design, development, testing and/or deployment of system functionality. Agile Dev Team Member III with primarily a development discipline provides technical feasibility using a range of coding methods and adheres to coding standards to ensure consistent style and format. Ensures systems are high in code and component quality, and are easily modified to support future requirements with support and limited guidance of more senior developers or architects. Agile Dev Team Member III with primarily a testing discipline ensures the end product meets the business acceptance criteria and non -functional requirements. Defines and executes tests early, often, and at multiple levels depending on their level of experience. Based on their business products, processes and system knowledge, they provide broad level of thinking for exceptions and other unexpected ways users may interact with systems. Utilizes intermediate testing techniques and tools.

**Exp- 5 to 7 years relevant experience**

**Tech Skill-**

* Guidewire PolicyCenter
* Java, REST API
Insurance Domain Knowledge  

  
  
**Requirements**

Demonstrates understanding to customer needs by interpreting customer needs into viable solutions, providing input into system design. Effectively writes and refines user stories, including clear and accurate acceptance criteria. Performs broad and detailed impact assessments relating people, processes and/or technology, and estimates user stories using relative sizing of story points. Supports implementation activities, troubleshooting user/system environmental issues, and training as required. Effectively supports business in building a Lean Business Case and breaking epics into features. Identifies and raises issues and risks with functional design. Partners with the Product Owner to confirm code and acceptance tests reflect the desired functionality. Executes Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) to build in quality. Agile Dev Team Member III with primarily a development discipline: Codes instructions for computer programs/objects/components; co nfigures packaged software. Provides input into the solution design and functionality of business applications. Reviews and validates application technical design of team members. Documents and implements programs according to standards and conventions. Analyzes and makes recommendations on the need for system backup, security, restart/recovery, balancing & controls and recommends approaches for meeting such needs. Analyzes and documents the requirements and approaches to data conversion and data modeling. Quality checks program code, related objects and documentation. Delivers working code each sprint. Demonstrates ability to read and write simple code. Modifies code in an existing file. Executes basic data creation tools and reads automation test results. Demonstrates understanding of the fundamentals of automation tools and framework. Agile Dev Team Member III with primarily a testing discipline: Analyzes system and business requirements for testability. Identifies complex errors that occur in standard application testing. Develops, documents, executes, and maintains test cases and test data. Reports status of test plan execution through defect logs and defect tracking system. Defines comprehensive test plans needed to achieve appropriate level of coverage. Analyzes test results and assists with trouble-shooting and root cause analysis. Utilizes standard testing tools such as data creation, run batch processes and test automation tools. Provides guidance to others as needed. Applies Risk Based Testing techniques to planning and execution. Writes test cases describing business behavior to facilitate automation. Mentors junior team members in test planning and execution techniques. Contributes to the overall test strategy with limited ability. Assists with resolution of environmental issues. Supports application development, implementation, and user training ac tivities, as required. Participates in key ceremonies to drive execution, improve flow and ensure transparency. May provide limited guidance to junior team members, when needed. Plans work via the preparation for and participation in Program Increment (PI) Planning and Sprint Planning, which includes developing and committing to Team PI Objectives and Sprint goals. Demonstrates working code to Product and Business Owners and supports the Product Owner in the execution of the iteration and PI System Demos. Actively participates in the Sprint Retrospectives and Inspect & Adapt to timely discuss opportunities for improvement and are responsible for carrying out the execution of improvement stories. Participates in Daily Stands-ups to assess progress toward sprint goals and raise impediments. Participates in on-going and scheduled Backlog Refinement sessions. Demonstrates ongoing desire for continuous improvement and building knowledge in area of expertise. Actively seeks out development opportunities to further develop T-shaped skills and become a more cross-functional contributor. Practices continuous exploration, continuous integration and continuous deployment necessary for building the Continuous Delivery Pipeline and implementing DevOps. Offers innovative ideas within area of focus to improve processes. Conducts ongoing assessment of current state and seeks out opportunities for improvement. Conducts research, design, prototyping and other exploration activities which fosters innovation and builds alignment between the customer need and what is delivered. Implements innovative ideas within area of focus. Actively participates in Agile Dev Team Member Community of Practice (CoP) and elicits contributions from group members. Plans and conducts CoP sessions. Effectively manages the communications and action items resulting from the sessions. Performs other functions as assigned.

title: Sr. Architect
description:

Senior Architect role for a global enterprise responsible for designing scalable microservices solutions on cloud platforms using Java Springboot and Angular while guiding agile scrum practices and modern DevOps automation. The position focuses on creating resilient hybrid model applications that enhance customer experience optimize engineering productivity and align with business strategy.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and architect scalable microservices based applications that enable reliable business services and improve overall system resilience for enterprise customers.
* Define robust application and integration architecture using Java Springboot and core Java so that complex business workflows are implemented with high performance and maintainability.
* Architect front end solutions using Angular frameworks to deliver intuitive and accessible user experiences that support diverse customer journeys and digital channels.
* Plan and implement cloud native solutions on AWS that leverage managed services to achieve secure deployments optimized cost structures and high availability across environments.
* Guide DevOps practices on AWS by promoting infrastructure automation continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines that reduce deployment risk and cycle times.
* Collaborate with product owners and cross functional squads in a scrum environment to translate business requirements into technical designs that are clear feasible and value driven.
* Review solution designs and code for microservices and cloud components to ensure alignment with architectural standards security guidelines and long term scalability objectives.

* Coordinate with hybrid work model teams across locations to ensure architecture decisions are communicated clearly risks are addressed early and delivery milestones are met on time.
* Optimize application performance and reliability by conducting detailed technical assessments capacity planning analyses and tuning across Java Springboot and database layers.
* Support incident and problem resolution by providing deep technical analysis of architecture and design issues and by recommending sustainable remediation strategies.
* Engage with stakeholders to explain architectural options and tradeoffs so that technology decisions are aligned with business priorities and regulatory considerations.
* Promote modern engineering practices such as test automation secure coding and observability for microservices based systems to enhance operational excellence and customer trust.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate between twelve and fifteen years of progressive experience in application architecture with a strong focus on distributed systems and enterprise scale platforms.
* Possess advanced hands on expertise in Java core Java and Springboot frameworks including designing and implementing complex Springboot microservices in production environments.
* Show practical experience in building and operating microservices architectures including service discovery fault tolerance configuration management and API design using industry standards.
* Have substantial exposure to AWS services such as compute storage networking and security features with a proven record of deploying and operating cloud native workloads.
* Bring solid knowledge of AWS DevOps tooling and practices including pipeline automation configuration management and environment standardization that supports frequent deployments.
* Exhibit strong proficiency in Angular for front end development with the ability to design modular components and responsive interfaces that integrate seamlessly with backend microservices.

title: Scrum Master
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**  
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

**Your day at NTT DATA**  
The Scrum Master is a seasoned subject matter expert, responsible for guiding and coaching teams in the use of Scrum / Agile practices.  
  
The primary responsibility of this role is to boost the effectiveness of teams by managing key projects, championing cross team alignment and delivering success and operationalizing underlying processes to make development teams hum effectively.  
  
The Scrum Masters resolves impediments, monitors and has control over the scrum processes and meetings.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Fosters a self-organizing and empowered environment that enables teams to deliver high-quality products on time and within budget.
* Facilitates and leads Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Ensures that teams adhere to the Scrum framework, follows agile best practices, and utilizes appropriate tools and metrics to track progress, identifies bottlenecks, and drives continuous improvement.
* Fosters effective communication and collaboration between cross-functional teams, product owners, and stakeholders.
* Acts as a bridge between technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring a shared understanding of the project goals, priorities, and timelines.
* Proactively addresses any conflicts or challenges that may hinder team performance and delivery.
* Collaboratively identifies and synchronizes project interdependencies across multiple teams. Facilitates effective resource allocation across the programs.
* Drives the continuous improvement of agile processes, methodologies, and tools across the organization. Identifies and implements process enhancements to optimize efficiency, productivity, and quality of deliverables.
* Encourages innovation to foster a culture of continuous leading and growth.
* Ensures the program benefits remain viable throughout the program, communicating status and date changes and actively manage dependencies.
* Builds strong relationships with key stakeholders and manages these expectations regarding project scope, timelines, and deliverables.
* Collaborates closely with product owners to prioritize backlog items and ensures alignment with business goals.
* Provides regular project status updates and communicates any risks or impediments that may impact project success.

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Ability to recognize the importance of working through others within the team through engaging and empowering others to use as much of their own capabilities as possible, thereby fostering trust and high energy to succeed.
* Has drive and energy to get the job done.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Assertive with the ability to come up with solutions to critical situations.
* Ability to make timely decisions and take calculated risks.
* Seasoned knowledge of other Agile approaches such as XP, Kanban, Scrum, extreme Programming (XP).
* Seasoned knowledge of the technologies used by the team.
* Ability to coordinate large teams with cross-functional dependencies.
* Proactive and organized with the ability to work in a fast-paced, team environment providing consistent, high-quality output.
* Ability to facilitate discussions to allow the team to consider alternative solutions or approaches and bring disagreements out into the open to help to manage them collaboratively.
* Ability to stimulate and relish change, adapt quickly and see change as an opportunity.

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Project Management or related field.
* Relevant certifications such as SAFe Scrum Master or SAFe Advanced Scrum Master preferred.
* Other related certifications and/or training (for example - SAFe DeVos, Implementing SAFe etc.).

* Seasoned Scrum Master experience in an ICT environment, managing software projects and working with software development teams.
* Seasoned experience in Scrum Management.
* Seasoned experience of Agile concepts and principles.
* Seasoned experience as a coach and mentor in agile practices (Scrum, Kanban etc.).
